20570.ins: The breast chain is the design centerpiece - it bridges the cups and does the styling that bare patent leather cannot, and the wings carry the devil read without a headband to lose. One size across the widest range the three-point format claims: 40-70 kg.
20570.short: Black patent leather little devil bikini set with breast chain and wings, three pieces, one size for 40-70 kg, Halloween ready.

20662.ins: The full combo - hip skirt, stockings, headwear - closes the matching question at the source, and the cow print is the playful animal option that suits a backless hip skirt better than the louder alternatives. One size for 40-60 kg.
20662.short: Backless cow-print set with hip skirt, stockings and headwear in two combo options, one size for 40-60 kg, as pictured.

19013.ins: White is the softer register against the bunny category's black default, and the S-M run carries printed per-size measurements - bust and waist for each - which puts the fit question to rest before ordering rather than after.
19013.short: White one-piece bunny set with headband in S and M, per-size bust and waist measurements printed, 40-60 kg by chart.
19013.td: White polyester bunny one-piece with headband, S and M sizes with printed bust and waist measurements for 40-60 kg by weight.

20186.ins: Box sizes are 5, 7, and 10 pieces and size bands are S, M, and L - both chosen at checkout, and the contents pull from across the catalog including items not yet listed. Intimate goods are final sale once shipped, which is the one fine print that matters.
20186.short: Mystery lingerie box in 5, 7 or 10 pieces with unreleased items from the catalog, sized S to L, final sale on intimate goods.

21008.ins: Four colorways on a real-leather base make this the default first collar: whatever the outfit runs, one of these matches, and the 40-50 cm adjustment covers the standard neck range with room to spare. The clasp hardware is the same across all four shades.
21008.short: Cute puppy leather collar in blue, white, black or pink with adjustable 40-50 cm circumference, four colorways, starter accessory.

21009.ins: The chain extends the collar into leash territory without committing to the full hardware of a dedicated set - the halfway design that most of this genre's wearers actually want. Sold as matched sets in black or pink, bell included and audible.
21009.short: Leather cat bell collar with attached chain in black or pink matched sets, adjustable 40-50 cm, audible bell at movement.

21010.ins: Hollow-out cutwork does the design work a charm would otherwise do - star shapes cut into the leather rather than hung from it, which means nothing swings and nothing catches. White or black on the same 40-50 cm adjustable band.
21010.short: Hollow-out star leather puppy collar in white or black, cutwork pattern, adjustable 40-50 cm, no dangling charms.

21011.ins: Pink leather is the sweet register in a collar category that runs mostly black, and the fixed heart-or-star charm keeps the design clean under collars and clothing alike. Two styles share the same band; pick at order and the rest is fixed.
21011.short: Pink leather choker with fixed heart or star charm in two styles, adjustable 40-50 cm, sweet-register collar accessory.

21012.ins: Double-layer construction flexes at the throat where a single wide band would sit stiff - the reason this format exists at all. The small bell is deliberately quieter than the big-bell versions, and white or black sets arrive with the chain matched.
21012.short: Double-layer leather collar with small quiet bell and chain in white or black sets, adjustable 40-50 cm, retro styling.

21013.ins: The bow-and-bell pairing is the genre's classic formula on a real-leather band rather than costume ribbon - the difference shows in a season of wear, where ribbon frays and leather does not. White or black, 40-50 cm adjustable.
21013.short: Leather collar with bow and big bell in white or black, adjustable 40-50 cm, classic cat formula in real leather.
